name: stage2_region_v91
description: capture_image_with_Bulb region from candidate 6.0.0.54.91 (astro-v1-camera-baseline-20261101). This is an ASTRO build: the FwPkt reuses the shared camera baseline, but the packet was produced by the Astro build line, not the main build that produced 6.0.0.54.90. Pinned so a lifecycle run is bound to this candidate's exact bytes rather than silently falling back to the v90 fixture.

provenance.region_extraction_coordinates: file_offset = symbol_vaddr + text_file_offset - text_vaddr; symbol capture_image_with_Bulb vaddr 0x101aac, size 2176. text vaddr/offset must be read from THIS ELF's section table, not copied from v90: the two binaries differ and a stale offset would extract the wrong bytes while still producing a loadable blob.
retrieval_procedure: 2. sha256sum FwPkt.zip  -> must equal fwpkt_sha256 above (verified 2026-11-02)

4. Extract /app/lib/stage2/pgphoto.stage2ondisk from appfs.ubifs with a UBIFS reader (ubireader or equivalent). The image is UBI version 1 with compressed payload; there is no plaintext ELF to carve, so carving cannot substitute for a real reader.
5. sha256sum pgphoto.stage2ondisk -> must equal source_binary_sha256 above
6. Derive the region from THIS ELF's .text section table and record region_sha256 here.
provenance.blocked_reason: Not extractable on this host as of 2026-11-02: no UBIFS reader is installed (ubireader, ubidump, jefferson, binwalk, unsquashfs all absent) and the package is not obtainable from PyPI under the name 'ubireader' (HTTP 404 on pypi.org/pypi/ubireader/json; pypi.org itself is reachable, HTTP 200). The exact missing input is /app/lib/stage2/pgphoto.stage2ondisk with SHA-256 b4a51cb7...b28e4, inside FwPkt/camera/appfs.ubifs of the candidate zip. This is a tooling gap, not a claim that runtime-derived fixture state is impermissible.
provenance.build_lineage_note: 6.0.0.54.90 came from the main build; 6.0.0.54.91 came from an Astro build. Both are published to the PrivateResearch repo under firmware-packets/. They are not interchangeable: their pgphoto.stage2ondisk differ (8973d948... vs b4a51cb7...) at identical size, so a result measured on one does not transfer to the other.
provenance.acceptance_status: candidate, not accepted. The packet README requires that the standard camera owner accept the baseline and that patcher issue #251 be closed or explicitly waived before install. Neither has happened, so nothing measured against this artifact qualifies it for deployment.
provenance.retained_at: PrivateResearch firmware-packets/6.0.0.54.91--astro-v1-camera-baseline-20261101/ (tracked in the PrivateResearch git repo; commit b298b601a records it)
provenance.blocked_reason_correction: An earlier revision of this field said 'no network access to install one'. That was wrong and has been replaced: pypi.org/pypi/requests/json returns 200 and github.com returns 200 from this host. The actual blocker is that no UBIFS reader is installed and ubireader is not published on PyPI under that name, so obtaining one means vendoring third-party code, which needs the repository owner's approval.
